import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT_PATH = ROOT / "scripts" / "import_knowledge_task_manifest.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("knowledge_task_manifest", SCRIPT_PATH)
MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)


class SeededReferenceAPI:
    """Read-only API fixture matching db/seeds/reference/reference_create.sql."""

    def __init__(self, languages=None):
        self.calls = []
        self.languages = (
            languages
            if languages is not None
            else [{"id": 1, "language": "en"}, {"id": 2, "language": "ru"}]
        )

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
        self.calls.append((method, path, body))
        if method != "GET":
            raise AssertionError(f"reference validation attempted {method} {path}")
        if path == "/i18n/list":
            return {"languages": self.languages}
        if path.startswith("/tech/list"):
            return {
                "techs": [
                    {"id": 11, "label": "javascript"},
                    {"id": 12, "label": "neutral"},
                    {"id": 13, "label": "java"},
                    {"id": 14, "label": "kotlin"},
                    {"id": 15, "label": "typescript"},
                ]
            }
        if path.startswith("/tech-version/list"):
            return {
                "tech_versions": [
                    {"id": 21, "tech_id": 11, "version": "1"},
                    {"id": 22, "tech_id": 12, "version": "1"},
                    {"id": 23, "tech_id": 13, "version": "1"},
                    {"id": 24, "tech_id": 14, "version": "1"},
                    {"id": 25, "tech_id": 15, "version": "1"},
                ]
            }
        if path.startswith("/code-structure-type/list"):
            return {
                "code_structure_types": [
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011", "code": "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC"},
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000012", "code": "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT"},
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000013", "code": "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC"},
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000014", "code": "TEST_ORDERING_BASIC"},
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000015", "code": "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_BASIC"},
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000016", "code": "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT"},
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000017", "code": "JAVA_BASIC_SCRIPT"},
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000018", "code": "KOTLIN_BASIC_SCRIPT"},
                    {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000019", "code": "HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT"},
                ]
            }
        if path.startswith("/tag/list"):
            return {
                "tags": [
                    {"id": 31, "slug": "javascript"},
                    {"id": 32, "slug": "beginner"},
                    {"id": 33, "slug": "neutral"},
                    {"id": 34, "slug": "java"},
                    {"id": 35, "slug": "kotlin"},
                    {"id": 36, "slug": "typescript"},
                ]
            }
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected reference request {method} {path}")


class KnowledgeTaskManifestTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.manifest = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / "knowledge-task-manifest.example.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        )
        self.neutral_manifest = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / "knowledge-task-manifest.neutral.example.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )

        self.quiz_only_manifests = {
            language: json.loads(
                (ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / f"knowledge-task-manifest.{language}-quiz.example.json").read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                )
            )
            for language in ("java", "kotlin")
        }
        self.typescript_runtime_manifest = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / "knowledge-task-manifest.typescript-runtime.example.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        self.java_runtime_manifest = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / "knowledge-task-manifest.java-runtime.example.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        self.kotlin_runtime_manifest = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / "knowledge-task-manifest.kotlin-runtime.example.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        self.browser_javascript_manifest = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / "knowledge-task-manifest.browser-javascript.example.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        self.browser_typescript_manifest = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / "knowledge-task-manifest.browser-typescript.example.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        self.runtime_profiles = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "test" / "fixtures" / "knowledge-runtime-profiles.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        )

    def test_course_catalog_visibility_is_optional_and_boolean(self):
        legacy = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        MODULE.validate_manifest(legacy)

        visible = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        visible["course"]["catalog_visible"] = True
        MODULE.validate_manifest(visible)

        invalid = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        invalid["course"]["catalog_visible"] = "hidden"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "course.catalog_visible"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(invalid)

    def test_lesson_read_access_is_optional_nullable_and_validated_at_every_node(self):
        valid = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        entities = [
            (valid["catalog"]["track"], "catalog.track"),
            (valid["catalog"]["level"], "catalog.level"),
            (valid["catalog"]["course_group"], "catalog.course_group"),
            (valid["course"], "course"),
            (valid["modules"][0], "modules[0]"),
            (valid["modules"][0]["sections"][0], "modules[0].sections[0]"),
            (valid["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0], "modules[0].sections[0].lessons[0]"),
        ]
        for (entity, _), value in zip(
            entities,
            ["guest", "student", None, "student_pro", "disabled", None, "guest"],
        ):
            entity["lesson_read_access"] = value
        MODULE.validate_manifest(valid)

        for index, (_, path) in enumerate(entities):
            with self.subTest(path=path):
                invalid = copy.deepcopy(valid)
                invalid_entities = [
                    invalid["catalog"]["track"],
                    invalid["catalog"]["level"],
                    invalid["catalog"]["course_group"],
                    invalid["course"],
                    invalid["modules"][0],
                    invalid["modules"][0]["sections"][0],
                    invalid["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0],
                ]
                invalid_entities[index]["lesson_read_access"] = "anonymous"
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "lesson_read_access"):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(invalid)

    def test_lesson_read_access_is_forwarded_only_when_declared(self):
        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, copy.deepcopy(body)))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith(("/track/list", "/level/list", "/course-group/list")):
                    collection = {
                        "/track/list": "tracks",
                        "/level/list": "levels",
                        "/course-group/list": "course_groups",
                    }
                    key = next(value for prefix, value in collection.items() if path.startswith(prefix))
                    return {key: []}
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/course/list"):
                    return {"courses": []}
                if method == "GET" and "/get/" in path:
                    return None
                return {}

        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        track = manifest["catalog"]["track"]
        level = manifest["catalog"]["level"]
        group = manifest["catalog"]["course_group"]
        course = manifest["course"]
        module = manifest["modules"][0]
        section = module["sections"][0]
        lesson = section["lessons"][0]
        track["lesson_read_access"] = "guest"
        level["lesson_read_access"] = "student"
        group["lesson_read_access"] = None
        course["lesson_read_access"] = "student_pro"
        module["lesson_read_access"] = "disabled"
        section["lesson_read_access"] = None
        lesson["lesson_read_access"] = "guest"
        MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api)
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 2, "en": 1}
        importer.tech_ids = {"neutral": 12}
        importer.tag_ids = {"neutral": 33}
        importer.upsert_catalog_entities(manifest["catalog"])
        course_id = importer.upsert_course(course)
        importer.publish_course()
        module_id = importer.upsert_module(course_id, module, course)
        importer.upsert_section(module_id, section, module, course)

        def create_body(path):
            return next(body for method, call_path, body in api.calls if method == "POST" and call_path == path)

        self.assertEqual(create_body("/track/create")["lesson_read_access"], "guest")
        self.assertEqual(create_body("/level/create")["lesson_read_access"], "student")
        self.assertIsNone(create_body("/course-group/create")["lesson_read_access"])
        self.assertEqual(create_body("/course/create")["lesson_read_access"], "student_pro")
        self.assertEqual(create_body("/module/create")["lesson_read_access"], "disabled")
        self.assertIsNone(create_body("/section/create")["lesson_read_access"])
        course_update = next(
            body for method, path, body in api.calls if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/course/update/")
        )
        self.assertEqual(course_update["lesson_read_access"], "student_pro")
        self.assertEqual(importer.lesson_body(lesson, tech_version_id=1, status=1)["lesson_read_access"], "guest")

        omitted = {}
        MODULE.copy_lesson_read_access({}, omitted)
        self.assertNotIn("lesson_read_access", omitted)
        MODULE.copy_lesson_read_access({"lesson_read_access": None}, omitted)
        self.assertIn("lesson_read_access", omitted)
        self.assertIsNone(omitted["lesson_read_access"])

    def test_course_catalog_visibility_is_forwarded_only_when_declared(self):
        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, copy.deepcopy(body)))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/course/list"):
                    return {"courses": []}
                return {}

        for declared in (None, False, True):
            with self.subTest(declared=declared):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
                if declared is not None:
                    manifest["course"]["catalog_visible"] = declared
                api = RecordingAPI()
                importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api)
                importer.language_ids = {"en": 1, "ru": 2}
                importer.tech_ids = {"neutral": 12}
                importer.tag_ids = {"neutral": 33}

                importer.upsert_course(manifest["course"])
                importer.publish_course()

                create_body = next(
                    body for method, path, body in api.calls if method == "POST" and path == "/course/create"
                )
                update_body = next(
                    body for method, path, body in api.calls if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/course/update/")
                )
                if declared is None:
                    self.assertNotIn("catalog_visible", create_body)
                    self.assertNotIn("catalog_visible", update_body)
                else:
                    self.assertIs(create_body["catalog_visible"], declared)
                    self.assertIs(update_body["catalog_visible"], declared)

    def test_course_api_batches_writes_and_uploads_starters_after_commit(self):
        class RecordingCourseAPI(MODULE.CourseAPI):
            def __init__(self):
                super().__init__()
                self.events = []

            def _request_now(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.events.append(("request", method, path, copy.deepcopy(body)))
                if method == "POST" and path == "/knowledge-import/batch":
                    return {"applied": len(body["operations"])}
                return None

            def _upload_starter_files_now(self, task_id, files):
                self.events.append(("upload", task_id, copy.deepcopy(files)))

        api = RecordingCourseAPI()
        api.begin_write_batch()
        api.request(
            "POST",
            "/track/create",
            {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000084", "slug": "foundation"},
        )
        queued = api.request(
            "GET",
            "/track/get/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000084",
            allow_not_found=True,
        )
        listed = api.request("GET", "/track/list?slug=foundation")
        api.request("DELETE", "/task/delete/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000085")
        api.upload_starter_files("task-id", [{"path": "main.js", "content": "// starter"}])

        self.assertEqual(queued["slug"], "foundation")
        self.assertEqual(listed["tracks"][0]["slug"], "foundation")
        self.assertFalse(any(event[0] == "upload" for event in api.events))

        api.commit_write_batch()

        batch_events = [event for event in api.events if event[:3] == ("request", "POST", "/knowledge-import/batch")]
        self.assertEqual(len(batch_events), 1)
        self.assertEqual(batch_events[0][3]["operations"][0]["path"], "/track/create")
        self.assertEqual(
            batch_events[0][3]["operations"][1],
            {
                "method": "DELETE",
                "path": "/task/delete/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000085",
                "body": {},
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(api.events[-1][0], "upload")
        self.assertFalse(
            any(event[:3] == ("request", "POST", "/track/create") for event in api.events),
            "individual write escaped the batch endpoint",
        )

        list_read = next(event for event in api.events if event[:3] == ("request", "GET", "/track/list?slug=foundation"))
        self.assertIsNotNone(list_read)

    def test_course_api_does_not_upload_starters_when_database_batch_fails(self):
        class FailingCourseAPI(MODULE.CourseAPI):
            def __init__(self):
                super().__init__()
                self.uploads = []

            def _request_now(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                if method == "POST" and path == "/knowledge-import/batch":
                    raise MODULE.ManifestError("database batch failed")
                return None

            def _upload_starter_files_now(self, task_id, files):
                self.uploads.append((task_id, files))

        api = FailingCourseAPI()
        api.begin_write_batch()
        api.request("POST", "/course/create", {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000084"})
        api.upload_starter_files("task-id", [{"path": "main.js", "content": "// starter"}])

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "database batch failed"):
            api.commit_write_batch()

        self.assertEqual(api.uploads, [])
        self.assertIsNone(api._write_batch)

    def test_course_api_scopes_queued_level_slug_reads_to_track(self):
        class EmptyCourseAPI(MODULE.CourseAPI):
            def _request_now(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
                return None

        first_track = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000081"
        second_track = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000082"
        first_level = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000091"
        api = EmptyCourseAPI()
        api.begin_write_batch()
        api.request("POST", "/level/create", {"id": first_level, "slug": "beginner"})
        api.request(
            "POST",
            "/track-relations/add-level/" + first_track,
            {"level_id": first_level, "order": 1},
        )

        first = api.request("GET", f"/level/list?slug=beginner&track_id={first_track}")
        second = api.request("GET", f"/level/list?slug=beginner&track_id={second_track}")

        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in first["levels"]], [first_level])
        self.assertEqual(second["levels"], [])

    @staticmethod
    def add_locale(manifest, language):
        def visit(value):
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                translations = value.get("translations")
                if isinstance(translations, dict) and "en" in translations:
                    translations[language] = copy.deepcopy(translations["en"])
                for key, item in value.items():
                    if key != "translations":
                        visit(item)
            elif isinstance(value, list):
                for item in value:
                    visit(item)

        visit(manifest)
        return manifest

    def make_cyclic_batch(self):
        base_prefix = self.neutral_manifest["course"]["source_key"]
        manifests = []
        for index, suffix in enumerate(("batch-a", "batch-b"), start=1):
            manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
            replacement = f"{base_prefix}-{suffix}"

            def rewrite(value):
                if isinstance(value, dict):
                    return {key: rewrite(item) for key, item in value.items()}
                if isinstance(value, list):
                    return [rewrite(item) for item in value]
                if isinstance(value, str) and (value == base_prefix or value.startswith(base_prefix + ".")):
                    return replacement + value[len(base_prefix) :]
                return value

            manifest = rewrite(manifest)
            manifest["course"]["slug"] += f"-{suffix}"
            manifest["catalog"]["course_order"] = index
            manifest["lesson_relations"][0]["source_key"] = f"lesson-relation.{suffix}"
            manifest["example_relations"][0]["source_key"] = f"example-relation.{suffix}"
            manifests.append(manifest)

        lessons = [[lesson["source_key"] for lesson in MODULE.iter_lessons(manifest)] for manifest in manifests]
        examples = [[example["source_key"] for example in manifest["examples"]] for manifest in manifests]
        manifests[0]["lesson_relations"][0]["target_lesson_key"] = lessons[1][1]
        manifests[1]["lesson_relations"][0]["target_lesson_key"] = lessons[0][1]
        manifests[0]["example_relations"][0]["target_example_key"] = examples[1][1]
        manifests[1]["example_relations"][0]["target_example_key"] = examples[0][1]
        return manifests

    def test_example_is_valid_and_has_stable_ids(self):
        MODULE.validate_manifest(self.manifest)
        key = self.manifest["course"]["source_key"]
        self.assertEqual(MODULE.source_uuid(key), MODULE.source_uuid(key))
        kinds = [kind for kind, _ in MODULE.iter_entities(self.manifest)]
        self.assertEqual(kinds[:4], ["track", "level", "course_group", "course"])

    def test_example_matches_deployed_reference_contract(self):
        MODULE.validate_manifest(self.manifest)
        api = SeededReferenceAPI()

        MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, api).check_references()

        self.assertTrue(api.calls)
        self.assertTrue(all(method == "GET" for method, _, _ in api.calls))

    def test_additional_locale_is_validated_and_preserved_in_payloads(self):
        manifest = self.add_locale(copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest), "de")

        MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)
        api = SeededReferenceAPI(
            languages=[
                {"id": 1, "language": "en"},
                {"id": 2, "language": "ru"},
                {"id": 3, "language": "de"},
            ]
        )
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api)
        importer.check_references()

        requirements = list(MODULE.iter_translation_requirements(manifest))
        self.assertTrue(any(language == "de" and path.startswith("catalog.track") for language, path in requirements))
        lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        lesson_payload = importer.lesson_body(lesson, tech_version_id=1, status=1)
        self.assertEqual([item["i18n_id"] for item in lesson_payload["translations"]], [2, 1, 3])

        classification_task = next(task for task in lesson["tasks"] if task["task_kind"] == "classification")
        question = MODULE.question_payload(classification_task["tests"][0], importer.language_ids)
        self.assertEqual([item["i18n_id"] for item in question["translations"]], [2, 1, 3])
        self.assertEqual([item["i18n_id"] for item in question["groups"][0]["translations"]], [2, 1, 3])
        self.assertEqual([item["i18n_id"] for item in question["variants"][0]["translations"]], [2, 1, 3])

    def test_course_upsert_writes_every_declared_locale(self):
        manifest = self.add_locale(copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest), "de")

        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/course/list"):
                    return {"courses": []}
                return {}

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api)
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 2, "en": 1, "de": 3}
        importer.tech_ids = {"neutral": 12}
        importer.tag_ids = {"neutral": 33}

        importer.upsert_course(manifest["course"])

        translations = [
            body
            for method, path, body in api.calls
            if method == "POST" and path.startswith("/course-i18n/create/")
        ]
        self.assertEqual([item["i18n_id"] for item in translations], [2, 1, 3])

    def test_additional_locale_must_exist_in_target_i18n_references(self):
        manifest = self.add_locale(copy.deepcopy(self.manifest), "de")
        MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)
        api = SeededReferenceAPI()

        with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError) as caught:
            MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api).check_references()

        self.assertIn("missing language 'de'", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIn("course.translations.de", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertTrue(all(method == "GET" for method, _, _ in api.calls))

    def test_ru_and_en_remain_required_for_legacy_fallback(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        del manifest["course"]["translations"]["en"]

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "missing required translations: en"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_ordering_and_classification_assessments_preserve_structure(self):
        base_question = self.manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]["tests"][0]

        ordering = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        ordering_task = ordering["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]
        ordering_task["task_kind"] = "ordering"
        ordering_task["code_structure_type_code"] = "TEST_ORDERING_BASIC"
        ordering_question = ordering_task["tests"][0]
        ordering_question["kind"] = "ordering"
        ordering_question["variants"][0].pop("is_correct")
        ordering_question["variants"][0]["correct_order"] = 2
        ordering_question["variants"][1].pop("is_correct")
        ordering_question["variants"][1]["correct_order"] = 1

        MODULE.validate_manifest(ordering)
        ordering_payload = MODULE.question_payload(ordering_question, {"ru": 2, "en": 1})
        self.assertEqual(ordering_payload["kind"], "ordering")
        self.assertEqual([item["correct_order"] for item in ordering_payload["variants"]], [2, 1])
        self.assertNotIn("is_correct", ordering_payload["variants"][0])

        classification = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        classification_task = classification["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]
        classification_task["task_kind"] = "classification"
        classification_task["code_structure_type_code"] = "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_BASIC"
        classification_question = classification_task["tests"][0]
        classification_question["kind"] = "classification"
        classification_question["groups"] = [
            {
                "source_key": base_question["source_key"] + ".group-a",
                "order": 1,
                "translations": {"ru": {"title": "Группа A"}, "en": {"title": "Group A"}},
            },
            {
                "source_key": base_question["source_key"] + ".group-b",
                "order": 2,
                "translations": {"ru": {"title": "Группа B"}, "en": {"title": "Group B"}},
            },
        ]
        for index, variant in enumerate(classification_question["variants"]):
            variant.pop("is_correct")
            variant["group_source_key"] = classification_question["groups"][index]["source_key"]

        MODULE.validate_manifest(classification)
        classification_payload = MODULE.question_payload(classification_question, {"ru": 2, "en": 1})
        self.assertEqual(classification_payload["kind"], "classification")
        self.assertEqual(len(classification_payload["groups"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(
            classification_payload["variants"][0]["group_source_key"],
            classification_payload["groups"][0]["source_key"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            classification_payload["groups"][0]["id"],
            MODULE.source_uuid(classification_payload["groups"][0]["source_key"]),
        )

    def test_structured_assessments_reject_invalid_answer_keys(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        task = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]
        task["task_kind"] = "ordering"
        task["code_structure_type_code"] = "TEST_ORDERING_BASIC"
        question = task["tests"][0]
        question["kind"] = "ordering"
        for variant in question["variants"]:
            variant.pop("is_correct")
            variant["correct_order"] = 1

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "duplicate correct order"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_neutral_quiz_manifest_matches_deployed_reference_contract(self):
        MODULE.validate_manifest(self.neutral_manifest)
        api = SeededReferenceAPI()

        MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.neutral_manifest, api).check_references()

        tasks = self.neutral_manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"]
        self.assertEqual(
            {task["task_kind"] for task in tasks},
            {"test", "quiz_theory", "ordering", "classification"},
        )
        self.assertTrue(all(not task["requires_sandbox"] for task in tasks))
        self.assertNotIn("runtime_profiles", self.neutral_manifest)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.neutral_manifest["lesson_relations"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.neutral_manifest["lesson_relations"][0]["relation"], "implementation")
        self.assertEqual(len(self.neutral_manifest["examples"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual({example["stacks"][0] for example in self.neutral_manifest["examples"]}, {"neutral", "javascript"})
        self.assertEqual(len(self.neutral_manifest["example_relations"]), 1)
        self.assertTrue(api.calls)
        self.assertTrue(all(method == "GET" for method, _, _ in api.calls))

    def test_java_and_kotlin_quiz_only_manifests_match_reference_contract(self):

                self.assertNotIn("runtime_profiles", manifest)
                self.assertNotIn("runtime_profile", lesson)
                self.assertEqual(task["task_kind"], "test")
                self.assertEqual(task["code_structure_type_code"], "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC")
                self.assertEqual(task["execution_mode"], "NO_RUN")
                self.assertEqual(task["submission_mode"], "ANSWER_PAYLOAD")
                self.assertFalse(task["requires_sandbox"])
                self.assertNotIn("starter_files", task)
                self.assertNotIn("code_structure", task)
                self.assertTrue(api.calls)
                self.assertTrue(all(method == "GET" for method, _, _ in api.calls))

    def test_sandbox_engine_preflight_accepts_configured_engines(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.typescript_runtime_manifest)
        task = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]

        class EngineAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = 0

            def configured_engine_ids(self):
                self.calls += 1
                return {"legacy.generic", "ts.ast", "ts.runtime"}

        api = EngineAPI()
        requirements = MODULE.check_sandbox_engine_readiness([manifest], api)

        self.assertEqual(set(requirements), {"ts.ast", "ts.runtime"})
        self.assertEqual(requirements["ts.ast"], {task["source_key"]})
        self.assertEqual(requirements["ts.runtime"], {task["source_key"]})
        self.assertEqual(api.calls, 1)

    def test_sandbox_engine_preflight_reports_missing_engines_and_tasks(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.typescript_runtime_manifest)
        task = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]

        class EngineAPI:
            def configured_engine_ids(self):
                return {"ts.ast"}

        with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError) as caught:
            MODULE.check_sandbox_engine_readiness([manifest], EngineAPI())

        message = str(caught.exception)
        self.assertIn("unconfigured engines", message)
        self.assertIn("ts.runtime", message)
        self.assertIn(task["source_key"], message)

    def test_sandbox_engine_preflight_skips_orchestrator_without_sandbox_tasks(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)

        class EngineAPI:
            def configured_engine_ids(self):
                raise AssertionError("orchestrator must not be called for non-sandbox content")

        requirements = MODULE.check_sandbox_engine_readiness([manifest], EngineAPI())

        self.assertEqual(requirements, {})

    def test_orchestrator_engine_discovery_rejects_malformed_response(self):
        class Response:
            def __enter__(self):
                return self

            def __exit__(self, *_):
                return False

            def read(self):
                return b'{"engines":["ts.ast","ts.ast"]}'

        api = MODULE.ValidationOrchestratorAPI("http://orchestrator:8080/")
        with mock.patch.object(MODULE.urllib.request, "urlopen", return_value=Response()) as urlopen:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "duplicate engine id"):
                api.configured_engine_ids()

        request = urlopen.call_args.args[0]
        self.assertEqual(request.full_url, "http://orchestrator:8080/api/v1/engines")
        self.assertEqual(urlopen.call_args.kwargs["timeout"], 30)

    def test_sandbox_engine_preflight_uses_scoped_task_set(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.typescript_runtime_manifest)
        lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        selected_task = lesson["tasks"][0]
        sibling = copy.deepcopy(selected_task)
        sibling["source_key"] += ".sibling"
        sibling["order"] += 1
        sibling["runtime_profile"] = "node-24-typescript"
        sibling["code_structure"]["stages"] = [
            {
                "id": "sibling-java",
                "engine": "java.compile",
                "mode": "both",
                "targets": {"files": ["main.ts"], "entrypoint": "main.ts"},
                "rules": {},
            }
        ]
        lesson["tasks"].append(sibling)

        scoped, _ = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
            [manifest],
            MODULE.ScopeSelector("task", selected_task["source_key"]),
        )
        requirements = MODULE.sandbox_engine_requirements(scoped)

        self.assertEqual(set(requirements), {"ts.ast", "ts.runtime"})
        self.assertNotIn("java.compile", requirements)

    def test_php_core_live_capability_requires_live_or_both_php_stage(self):
        task = {"supports_live_validation": True}
        contract = {
            "version": 1,
            "kind": "workspace_contract",
            "stages": [
                {"id": "php", "engine": "php.core", "mode": "final"},
                {"id": "css", "engine": "css.ast", "mode": "both"},
            ],
        }

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "requires php.core in live or both mode"):
            MODULE.validate_php_core_live_validation_capability(task, contract, "task")

        contract["stages"][0]["mode"] = "both"
        MODULE.validate_php_core_live_validation_capability(task, contract, "task")

        contract["stages"][0]["mode"] = "final"
        task["supports_live_validation"] = False
        MODULE.validate_php_core_live_validation_capability(task, contract, "task")

    def test_validation_stage_dependency_must_share_every_request_mode(self):
        contract = {
            "version": 1,
            "kind": "workspace_contract",
            "stages": [
                {"id": "php-structure", "engine": "php.core", "mode": "live"},
                {
                    "id": "exact-output",
                    "engine": "linux.runtime",
                    "mode": "final",
                    "depends_on": ["php-structure"],
                },
            ],
        }

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "dependency 'php-structure' does not"):
            MODULE.validate_validation_stage_mode_dependencies(contract, "task")

        contract["stages"][0]["mode"] = "both"
        MODULE.validate_validation_stage_mode_dependencies(contract, "task")

    def test_typescript_runtime_manifest_rejects_unsafe_contract_variants(self):
        mutations = {
            "live runtime": lambda task, runtime: runtime.__setitem__("mode", "both"),
            "authored command": lambda task, runtime: runtime["checks"].__setitem__("command", ["node", "main.ts"]),
            "missing output assertion": lambda task, runtime: runtime["checks"].__setitem__("expect", {"exitCode": 0}),
            "workspace escape": lambda task, runtime: (
                runtime["targets"].__setitem__("entrypoint", "../main.ts"),
                runtime["targets"].__setitem__("files", ["../main.ts"]),
            ),
            "missing starter": lambda task, runtime: task.__setitem__("starter_files", []),
        }
        for name, mutate in mutations.items():
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.typescript_runtime_manifest)
                task = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]
                runtime = task["code_structure"]["stages"][1]
                mutate(task, runtime)
                with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_browser_runtime_manifests_match_reference_contracts(self):
        cases = (
            (self.browser_javascript_manifest, "browser-javascript", "js.ast", "app.js", False),
            (self.browser_typescript_manifest, "browser-typescript", "ts.ast", "app.ts", True),
        )
        for manifest, runtime_profile, script_engine, script_file, has_build in cases:
            with self.subTest(runtime_profile=runtime_profile):
                MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)
                api = SeededReferenceAPI()
                MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api).check_references()

                lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
                self.assertEqual(lesson["runtime_profile"], runtime_profile)
                for task in lesson["tasks"]:
                    stages = task["code_structure"]["stages"]
                    browser = stages[2]
                    self.assertEqual([stage["engine"] for stage in stages], ["html.dom", script_engine, "browser.runtime"])
                    self.assertEqual([stage["mode"] for stage in stages], ["both", "both", "final"])
                    self.assertEqual(set(task["code_structure"]["workspace"]["required_files"]), {"index.html", script_file})
                    self.assertEqual("build" in browser["checks"], has_build)
                    self.assertEqual(task["task_kind"], "frontend_preview")
                    self.assertTrue(task["exposes_preview"])
                    self.assertFalse(task["exposes_terminal"])
                self.assertTrue(api.calls)

    def test_browser_runtime_manifest_rejects_unsafe_contract_variants(self):
        mutations = {
            "live browser": lambda task, browser: browser.__setitem__("mode", "both"),
            "unsupported action": lambda task, browser: browser["checks"]["interactions"][0].__setitem__("action", "hover"),
            "missing static dependency": lambda task, browser: browser.__setitem__("depends_on", browser["depends_on"][:1]),
            "wrong runtime profile": lambda task, browser: task.__setitem__("runtime_profile", "browser-typescript"),
        }
        for name, mutate in mutations.items():
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.browser_javascript_manifest)
                lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
                task = lesson["tasks"][0]
                browser = task["code_structure"]["stages"][2]
                if name == "wrong runtime profile":
                    lesson["runtime_profile"] = "browser-typescript"
                    manifest["runtime_profiles"]["browser-typescript"] = copy.deepcopy(
                        self.runtime_profiles["browser-typescript"]
                    )
                else:
                    mutate(task, browser)
                with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_java_runtime_manifest_rejects_unsafe_contract_variants(self):
        mutations = {
            "live runtime": lambda task, stages: stages[1].__setitem__("mode", "both"),
            "final compile": lambda task, stages: stages[0].__setitem__("mode", "final"),
            "authored command": lambda task, stages: stages[1]["checks"].__setitem__(
                "command", ["java", "Main"]
            ),
            "missing compile dependency": lambda task, stages: stages[1].__setitem__("depends_on", []),
            "validation link": lambda task, stages: task["code_structure"]["links"].append(
                {"id": "extra", "kind": "workspace.file_contains", "depends_on": [stages[0]["id"]]}
            ),
            "wrong entrypoint": lambda task, stages: stages[1].__setitem__(
                "targets", {"files": ["src/Main.java"], "entrypoint": "src/Main.java"}
            ),
            "nonempty rules": lambda task, stages: stages[0].__setitem__("rules", {"classpath": ["lib.jar"]}),
            "extra Java source": lambda task, stages: task["starter_files"].append(
                {"path": "Helper.java", "content": "class Helper {}\n"}
            ),
            "package declaration": lambda task, stages: task["starter_files"][0].__setitem__(
                "content", "package course;\npublic class Main {}\n"
            ),
            "wrong structure type": lambda task, stages: task.__setitem__(
                "code_structure_type_code", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT"
            ),
        }
        for name, mutate in mutations.items():
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.java_runtime_manifest)
                task = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]
                stages = task["code_structure"]["stages"]
                mutate(task, stages)
                with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_kotlin_runtime_manifest_rejects_unsafe_contract_variants(self):
        mutations = {
            "live runtime": lambda task, stages: stages[1].__setitem__("mode", "both"),

                "targets", {"files": ["src/Main.kt"], "entrypoint": "src/Main.kt"}

            ),
            "wrong structure type": lambda task, stages: task.__setitem__(
                "code_structure_type_code", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT"

    def test_reference_check_reports_every_missing_reference(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["course"]["tech_labels"] = ["missing-course-tech"]
        manifest["course"]["tag_slugs"] = ["missing-tag"]
        manifest["modules"][0]["tech_label"] = "missing-module-tech"
        section = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]
        section["tech_version"]["version"] = "missing-version"
        section["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]["code_structure_type_code"] = "MISSING_TEST_STRUCTURE"
        MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError) as caught:
            MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, SeededReferenceAPI()).check_references()

        report = str(caught.exception)
        for expected in (
            "missing-course-tech",
            "missing-module-tech",
            "missing-version",
            "missing-tag",
            "MISSING_TEST_STRUCTURE",
        ):
            self.assertIn(expected, report)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(report.count("\n- missing"), 5)

    def test_reference_check_explains_case_sensitive_matching(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["course"]["main_tech_label"] = "JavaScript"
        MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError) as caught:
            MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, SeededReferenceAPI()).check_references()

        self.assertIn("case differs from deployed value 'javascript'", str(caught.exception))

    def test_apply_rejects_missing_references_before_any_write(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["course"]["tag_slugs"] = ["missing-tag"]
        api = SeededReferenceAPI()

        with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
            MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api).apply()

        self.assertTrue(api.calls)
        self.assertTrue(all(method == "GET" for method, _, _ in api.calls))

    def test_reference_values_must_already_be_canonical(self):
        for field, value in (("main_tech_label", " javascript "), ("tech_labels", [" javascript "])):
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
                manifest["course"][field] = value

                with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "must not contain leading or trailing whitespace"):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_duplicate_source_key_is_rejected(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]["tests"][0]["variants"][1]["source_key"] = (
            manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]["tests"][0]["variants"][0]["source_key"]
        )

        with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_lesson_relations_are_validated_and_have_stable_ids(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        source_lesson_key = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["source_key"]
        relation = {
            "source_key": "lesson-relation.sequence.javascript",
            "source_lesson_key": source_lesson_key,
            "target_lesson_key": "knowledge-tree.programming-languages.beginner.javascript-core.output.loop",
            "relation": "implementation",
            "primary_stack": "javascript",
            "stacks": ["javascript"],
            "concepts": ["sequence"],
        }
        manifest["lesson_relations"] = [relation]

        MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        entities = list(MODULE.iter_entities(manifest))
        self.assertEqual(entities[-1], ("lesson_relation", relation))
        self.assertEqual(MODULE.source_uuid(relation["source_key"]), MODULE.source_uuid(relation["source_key"]))

        for kind in MODULE.LESSON_RELATION_KINDS:
            with self.subTest(kind=kind):
                candidate = copy.deepcopy(manifest)
                candidate["lesson_relations"][0]["relation"] = kind
                MODULE.validate_manifest(candidate)

    def test_lesson_relations_reject_invalid_or_duplicate_edges(self):
        source_lesson_key = self.manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["source_key"]
        base = {
            "source_key": "lesson-relation.sequence.javascript",
            "source_lesson_key": source_lesson_key,
            "target_lesson_key": "knowledge-tree.programming-languages.beginner.javascript-core.output.loop",
            "relation": "implementation",
            "primary_stack": "javascript",
            "stacks": ["javascript"],
            "concepts": ["sequence"],
        }
        cases = {
            "self": {**base, "target_lesson_key": source_lesson_key},
            "unsupported": {**base, "relation": "planned"},
            "primary stack mismatch": {**base, "stacks": ["go"]},
            "unknown source": {**base, "source_lesson_key": "external.lesson"},
        }
        for name, relation in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
                manifest["lesson_relations"] = [relation]
                with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        duplicate = {**base, "source_key": "lesson-relation.sequence.javascript.duplicate"}
        manifest["lesson_relations"] = [base, duplicate]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "duplicate semantic lesson relation"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_manifest_rejects_unknown_root_and_lesson_fields(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["planned_examples"] = []
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "unsupported fields: planned_examples"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["planned_related_lessons"] = []
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "unsupported fields: planned_related_lessons"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_first_class_examples_and_relations_are_valid(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        lesson_key = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["source_key"]
        example = {
            "source_key": lesson_key + ".neutral-example",
            "lesson_source_key": lesson_key,
            "order": 1,
            "status": 1,
            "mode": "concept-snippet",
            "primary_stack": "neutral",
            "stacks": ["neutral"],
            "target_concepts": ["sequence"],
            "translations": {
                "ru": {"title": "Порядок", "description": "Нейтральный пример **порядка**."},
                "en": {"title": "Order", "description": "A neutral **order** example."},
            },
        }
        relation = {
            "source_key": "example-relation.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
            "source_example_key": example["source_key"],
            "target_example_key": lesson_key + ".javascript-example",
            "relation": "implementation",
            "primary_stack": "javascript",
            "stacks": ["javascript"],
            "concepts": ["sequence"],
        }
        manifest["examples"] = [example]
        manifest["example_relations"] = [relation]

        MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        entities = list(MODULE.iter_entities(manifest))
        self.assertIn(("lesson_example", example), entities)
        self.assertEqual(entities[-1], ("example_relation", relation))

    def test_examples_reject_invalid_ownership_order_and_metadata(self):
        lesson_key = self.manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["source_key"]
        base = {
            "source_key": lesson_key + ".neutral-example",
            "lesson_source_key": lesson_key,
            "order": 1,
            "status": 1,
            "mode": "concept-snippet",
            "stacks": ["neutral"],
            "target_concepts": ["sequence"],
            "translations": {
                "ru": {"title": "Порядок", "description": "Описание."},
                "en": {"title": "Order", "description": "Description."},
            },
        }
        cases = {
            "unknown lesson": {**base, "lesson_source_key": "external.lesson"},
            "zero order": {**base, "order": 0},
            "invalid mode": {**base, "mode": "Concept Snippet"},
            "empty stacks": {**base, "stacks": []},
            "primary mismatch": {**base, "primary_stack": "javascript"},
        }
        for name, example in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
                manifest["examples"] = [example]
                with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        example_with_unknown_translation = copy.deepcopy(base)
        example_with_unknown_translation["translations"]["en"]["runtime"] = "node"
        manifest["examples"] = [example_with_unknown_translation]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "unsupported fields: runtime"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        duplicate = {**base, "source_key": lesson_key + ".second-example"}
        manifest["examples"] = [base, duplicate]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "duplicate example order"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_example_relations_reject_self_dangling_source_and_duplicates(self):
        lesson_key = self.manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["source_key"]
        example_key = lesson_key + ".neutral-example"
        example = {
            "source_key": example_key,
            "lesson_source_key": lesson_key,
            "order": 1,
            "status": 1,
            "mode": "concept-snippet",
            "stacks": ["neutral"],
            "target_concepts": ["sequence"],
            "translations": {
                "ru": {"title": "Порядок", "description": "Описание."},
                "en": {"title": "Order", "description": "Description."},
            },
        }
        base = {
            "source_key": "example-relation.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
            "source_example_key": example_key,
            "target_example_key": lesson_key + ".javascript-example",
            "relation": "implementation",
            "primary_stack": "javascript",
            "stacks": ["javascript"],
            "concepts": ["sequence"],
        }
        cases = {
            "self": {**base, "target_example_key": example_key},
            "dangling source": {**base, "source_example_key": "external.example"},
            "missing primary": {key: value for key, value in base.items() if key != "primary_stack"},
            "primary mismatch": {**base, "stacks": ["go"]},
        }
        for name, relation in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
                manifest["examples"] = [example]
                manifest["example_relations"] = [relation]
                with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["examples"] = [example]
        manifest["example_relations"] = [
            base,
            {**base, "source_key": "example-relation.abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789"},
        ]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "duplicate semantic example relation"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_example_reconciliation_uses_stable_ids_and_exact_translations(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        lesson_key = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["source_key"]
        example = {
            "source_key": lesson_key + ".neutral-example",
            "lesson_source_key": lesson_key,
            "order": 1,
            "status": 1,
            "mode": "concept-snippet",
            "stacks": ["neutral"],
            "target_concepts": ["sequence"],
            "translations": {
                "ru": {"title": "Порядок", "description": "RU Markdown"},
                "en": {"title": "Order", "description": "EN Markdown"},
            },
        }
        relation = {
            "source_key": "example-relation.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
            "source_example_key": example["source_key"],
            "target_example_key": lesson_key + ".javascript-example",
            "relation": "implementation",
            "primary_stack": "javascript",
            "stacks": ["javascript"],
            "concepts": ["sequence"],
        }
        manifest["examples"] = [example]
        manifest["example_relations"] = [relation]

        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                return {}

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api)
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 2, "en": 1}
        importer.replace_lesson_examples()
        importer.replace_example_relations()

        example_call = api.calls[0]
        self.assertEqual(example_call[0:2], ("PUT", "/lesson-examples/replace/" + MODULE.source_uuid(lesson_key)))
        payload = example_call[2]["examples"][0]
        self.assertEqual(payload["id"], MODULE.source_uuid(example["source_key"]))
        self.assertEqual(payload["translations"][0], {"i18n_id": 2, "title": "Порядок", "description": "RU Markdown"})
        relation_call = api.calls[1]
        self.assertEqual(
            relation_call[0:2],
            ("PUT", "/example-relations/replace/" + MODULE.source_uuid(example["source_key"])),
        )
        self.assertEqual(relation_call[2]["relations"][0]["id"], MODULE.source_uuid(relation["source_key"]))

    def test_relation_reconciliation_replaces_every_manifest_lesson(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        source_lesson_key = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["source_key"]
        relation = {
            "source_key": "lesson-relation.sequence.javascript",
            "source_lesson_key": source_lesson_key,
            "target_lesson_key": "knowledge-tree.programming-languages.beginner.javascript-core.output.loop",
            "relation": "reference",
            "stacks": [],
            "concepts": ["sequence"],
        }
        manifest["lesson_relations"] = [relation]

        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                return {}

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api)
        importer.replace_lesson_relations()

        self.assertEqual(
            api.calls,
            [
                (
                    "PUT",
                    "/lesson-relations/replace/" + MODULE.source_uuid(source_lesson_key),
                    {
                        "relations": [
                            {
                                "id": MODULE.source_uuid(relation["source_key"]),
                                "source_key": relation["source_key"],
                                "target_lesson_id": MODULE.source_uuid(relation["target_lesson_key"]),
                                "relation": "reference",
                                "stacks": [],
                                "concepts": ["sequence"],
                            }
                        ]
                    },
                )
            ],
        )

    def test_test_task_requires_single_correct_option(self):

        variants[1]["is_correct"] = True
