    def test_sandbox_task_requires_resolved_runtime_profile(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        del lesson["runtime_profile"]

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "sandbox task requires"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_null_runtime_profile_is_rejected(self):
        for target in ("lesson", "task"):
            with self.subTest(target=target):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
                lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
                if target == "lesson":
                    lesson["runtime_profile"] = None
                else:
                    lesson["tasks"][1]["runtime_profile"] = None

                with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "must be a non-empty string"):
                    MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_task_runtime_profile_overrides_lesson_profile(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-override"] = copy.deepcopy(manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-20"])
        lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        coding_task = lesson["tasks"][1]
        coding_task["runtime_profile"] = "node-override"

        MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)
        bindings = list(MODULE.iter_runtime_bindings(manifest))

        self.assertIn(("lesson", lesson["source_key"], "node-20", "lesson"), bindings)
        self.assertIn(("task", coding_task["source_key"], "node-override", "task"), bindings)

    def test_runtime_profile_rejects_incompatible_tech_or_code(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        lesson["runtime_profile"] = "node-20"
        manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["tech_label"] = "Go"

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "does not support tech_label"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][1]["code_structure_type_code"] = "GO_BASIC_SCRIPT"

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "does not support code structure"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_runtime_fixture_covers_javascript_typescript_jvm_go_python_and_php(self):
        cases = (
            ("node-20", "javascript", "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT"),
            ("browser-javascript", "javascript", "HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT"),
            ("node-24-typescript", "typescript", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT"),
            ("browser-typescript", "typescript", "HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT"),
            ("java-21", "java", "JAVA_BASIC_SCRIPT"),
            ("kotlin-2.3-jdk21", "kotlin", "KOTLIN_BASIC_SCRIPT"),
            ("go-1.25", "go", "GO_BASIC_SCRIPT"),
            ("python-3.12", "python", "PYTHON_BASIC_SCRIPT"),
            ("php-8.2", "php", "PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT"),
        )
        for profile_name, tech_label, structure_code in cases:
            with self.subTest(profile=profile_name):
                manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
                manifest["runtime_profiles"] = copy.deepcopy(self.runtime_profiles)
                section = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]
                section["tech_label"] = tech_label
                section["tech_version"]["label"] = tech_label
                lesson = section["lessons"][0]
                lesson["runtime_profile"] = profile_name
                lesson["tasks"][1]["code_structure_type_code"] = structure_code

                MODULE.validate_manifest(manifest)

    def test_relation_reorder_uses_non_conflicting_temporary_orders(self):
        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, api)
        importer.upsert_ordered_relations(
            "/course-relations/add-module/course-id",
            "module_id",
            [("module-a", 1), ("module-b", 0)],
        )

        self.assertEqual(
            api.calls,
            [
                ("POST", "/course-relations/add-module/course-id", {"module_id": "module-a", "order": -32768}),
                ("POST", "/course-relations/add-module/course-id", {"module_id": "module-b", "order": -32767}),
                ("POST", "/course-relations/add-module/course-id", {"module_id": "module-a", "order": 1}),
                ("POST", "/course-relations/add-module/course-id", {"module_id": "module-b", "order": 0}),
            ],
        )

    def test_catalog_upsert_refuses_unmanaged_slug(self):
        class CollisionAPI:
            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                if path.startswith("/track/list"):
                    return {"tracks": [{"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099", "slug": "programming-languages"}]}
                return None

        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, CollisionAPI())
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 1, "en": 2}

        with self.assertRaises(MODULE.ManifestError):
            importer.upsert_catalog_entity("track", "track", "tracks", self.manifest["catalog"]["track"])

    def test_level_slug_collision_is_checked_inside_track_scope(self):
        track_id = MODULE.source_uuid(self.manifest["catalog"]["track"]["source_key"])

        class ScopedLevelAPI:
            def __init__(self, collision=False):
                self.calls = []
                self.collision = collision

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if path.startswith("/level/list"):
                    self.assert_scoped(path)
                    if self.collision:
                        return {"levels": [{"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099", "slug": "beginner"}]}
                    return {"levels": []}
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/level/get/"):
                    return None
                return {}

            @staticmethod
            def assert_scoped(path):
                if f"track_id={track_id}" not in path:
                    raise AssertionError(f"level slug lookup is not scoped to its Track: {path}")

        api = ScopedLevelAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, api)
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 1, "en": 2}
        importer.upsert_catalog_entity(
            "level",
            "level",
            "levels",
            self.manifest["catalog"]["level"],
            slug_scope={"track_id": track_id},
        )
        self.assertTrue(any(method == "POST" and path == "/level/create" for method, path, _ in api.calls))

        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, ScopedLevelAPI(collision=True))
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 1, "en": 2}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "Refusing to overwrite unmanaged content"):
            importer.upsert_catalog_entity(
                "level",
                "level",
                "levels",
                self.manifest["catalog"]["level"],
                slug_scope={"track_id": track_id},
            )

    def test_apply_creates_then_updates_same_deterministic_resources(self):
        class FakeAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []
                self.resources = {
                    "track": set(),
                    "level": set(),
                    "course-group": set(),
                    "module": set(),
                    "section": set(),
                    "lesson": set(),
                    "task": set(),
                }
                self.catalog_slugs = {"track": {}, "level": {}, "course-group": {}}
                self.course_id = None
                self.task_kinds = {}
                self.uploads = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if path == "/i18n/list":
                    return {"languages": [{"id": 1, "language": "en"}, {"id": 2, "language": "ru"}]}
                if path.startswith("/tech/list"):
                    return {"techs": [{"id": 11, "label": "javascript"}]}
                if path.startswith("/tech-version/list"):
                    return {"tech_versions": [{"id": 21, "tech_id": 11, "version": "1"}]}
                if path.startswith("/code-structure-type/list"):
                    return {
                        "code_structure_types": [
                            {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011", "code": "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC"},
                            {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000012", "code": "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT"},
                        ]
                    }
                if path.startswith("/tag/list"):
                    return {"tags": []}
                for endpoint, collection in (("track", "tracks"), ("level", "levels"), ("course-group", "course_groups")):
                    if path.startswith(f"/{endpoint}/list"):
                        return {
                            collection: [
                                {"id": resource_id, "slug": slug}
                                for resource_id, slug in self.catalog_slugs[endpoint].items()
                            ]
                        }
                if path.startswith("/course/list"):
                    return {"courses": [] if self.course_id is None else [{"id": self.course_id, "slug": "knowledge-tree-javascript-core"}]}
                for kind in self.resources:
                    prefix = f"/{kind}/get/"
                    if path.startswith(prefix):
                        resource_id = path[len(prefix) :]
                        if resource_id not in self.resources[kind]:
                            return None
                        if kind == "task":
                            return {"task_kind": self.task_kinds[resource_id]}
                        return {kind: {"id": resource_id}}
                if method == "POST" and path == "/course/create":
                    self.course_id = body["id"]
                if method == "POST" and path in {
                    "/track/create",
                    "/level/create",
                    "/course-group/create",
                    "/module/create",
                    "/section/create",
                    "/lesson/create",
                    "/task/create",
                }:
                    kind = path.split("/")[1]
                    self.resources[kind].add(body["id"])
                    if kind in self.catalog_slugs:
                        self.catalog_slugs[kind][body["id"]] = body["slug"]
                    if kind == "task":
                        self.task_kinds[body["id"]] = body["task_kind"]
                if method == "PUT" and any(path.startswith(f"/{kind}/update/") for kind in self.catalog_slugs):
                    kind = path.split("/")[1]
                    resource_id = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
                    self.catalog_slugs[kind][resource_id] = body["slug"]
                return {}

            def upload_starter_files(self, task_id, files):
                self.uploads.append((task_id, files))

        api = FakeAPI()
        first_actions = MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, api).apply()
        second_actions = MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, api).apply()

        self.assertTrue(any(action.startswith("create  task") for action in first_actions))
        self.assertTrue(any(action.startswith("create  track") for action in first_actions))
        self.assertFalse(any(action.startswith("create  ") for action in second_actions))
        self.assertTrue(any(action.startswith("update  task") for action in second_actions))
        self.assertTrue(any(action.startswith("update  course_group") for action in second_actions))
        self.assertEqual(len(api.uploads), 2)

        track_writes = [
            body
            for method, path, body in api.calls
            if (method == "POST" and path == "/track/create") or (method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/track/update/"))
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(track_writes), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(body["order"] == self.manifest["catalog"]["track_order"] for body in track_writes))

        relation_paths = [
            path
            for method, path, _ in api.calls
            if method == "PUT" and "-relations/replace-" in path
        ]
        self.assertIn("/track-relations/replace-levels/" + MODULE.source_uuid(self.manifest["catalog"]["track"]["source_key"]), relation_paths)
        self.assertEqual(len([path for path in relation_paths if path.startswith("/course-group-relations/replace-courses/")]), 2)

        task_updates = [body for method, path, body in api.calls if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/task/update/")]
        self.assertTrue(task_updates)
        self.assertEqual(task_updates[-1]["max_attempts"], 3)
        self.assertIsNone(task_updates[-1]["compose_config"])

        expected_compose = self.manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-20"]["compose_config"]
        lesson_writes = [
            body
            for method, path, body in api.calls
            if (method, path) == ("POST", "/lesson/create") or (method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/lesson/update/"))
        ]
        self.assertTrue(lesson_writes)
        self.assertTrue(all(body["compose_config"] == expected_compose for body in lesson_writes))

    def test_task_runtime_override_is_sent_on_create_and_update(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-override"] = copy.deepcopy(manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-20"])
        manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-override"]["compose_config"]["services"]["app"]["image"] = "node:22-alpine"
        task = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][1]
        task["runtime_profile"] = "node-override"

        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self, existing):
                self.existing = existing
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/task/get/"):
                    return {"task_kind": task["task_kind"]} if self.existing else None
                return {}

            def upload_starter_files(self, *_):
                return None

        expected_compose = manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-override"]["compose_config"]
        for existing, expected_method in ((False, "POST"), (True, "PUT")):
            with self.subTest(existing=existing):
                api = RecordingAPI(existing)
                importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api)
                importer.language_ids = {"ru": 2, "en": 1}
                importer.structure_type_ids = {task["code_structure_type_code"]: "structure-id"}
                importer.upsert_task("lesson-id", task)

                writes = [(method, body) for method, path, body in api.calls if method == expected_method and "/task/" in path]
                self.assertEqual(len(writes), 1)
                self.assertEqual(writes[0][1]["compose_config"], expected_compose)
                self.assertNotIn("tests", writes[0][1])

    def test_existing_lesson_runtime_is_persisted_before_inherited_task_updates(self):
        lesson = self.manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]

        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/lesson/get/"):
                    return {"id": path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1], "status": 1}
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/task/get/"):
                    return {"task_kind": "test" if path.endswith(MODULE.source_uuid(lesson["tasks"][0]["source_key"])) else "cli_programming"}
                return {}

            def upload_starter_files(self, *_):
                return None

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, api)
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 2, "en": 1}
        importer.structure_type_ids = {
            "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC": "test-structure",
            "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT": "code-structure",
        }

        importer.upsert_lesson(lesson, tech_version_id=1)

        lesson_update_indexes = [
            index
            for index, (method, path, _) in enumerate(api.calls)
            if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/lesson/update/")
        ]
        task_update_indexes = [
            index
            for index, (method, path, _) in enumerate(api.calls)
            if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/task/update/")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(lesson_update_indexes), 2)
        self.assertTrue(task_update_indexes)
        self.assertLess(lesson_update_indexes[0], min(task_update_indexes))
        self.assertLess(max(task_update_indexes), lesson_update_indexes[1])
        self.assertEqual(api.calls[lesson_update_indexes[0]][2]["status"], 1)

    def test_lesson_runtime_is_cleared_after_task_overrides_are_persisted(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-override"] = copy.deepcopy(manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-20"])
        manifest["runtime_profiles"]["node-override"]["compose_config"]["services"]["app"]["image"] = "node:22-alpine"
        lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        del lesson["runtime_profile"]
        lesson["tasks"][1]["runtime_profile"] = "node-override"

        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/lesson/get/"):
                    return {"id": path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1], "status": 1}
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/task/get/"):
                    is_test = path.endswith(MODULE.source_uuid(lesson["tasks"][0]["source_key"]))
                    return {"task_kind": "test" if is_test else "cli_programming"}
                return {}

            def upload_starter_files(self, *_):
                return None

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api)
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 2, "en": 1}
        importer.structure_type_ids = {
            "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC": "test-structure",
            "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT": "code-structure",
        }

        importer.upsert_lesson(lesson, tech_version_id=1)

        lesson_updates = [
            (index, body)
            for index, (method, path, body) in enumerate(api.calls)
            if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/lesson/update/")
        ]
        task_update_indexes = [
            index
            for index, (method, path, _) in enumerate(api.calls)
            if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/task/update/")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(lesson_updates), 2)
        self.assertNotIn("compose_config", lesson_updates[0][1])
        self.assertIsNone(lesson_updates[1][1]["compose_config"])
        self.assertLess(lesson_updates[0][0], min(task_update_indexes))
        self.assertLess(max(task_update_indexes), lesson_updates[1][0])

    def test_batch_validation_accepts_cycles_and_requires_relation_closure(self):
        manifests = self.make_cyclic_batch()

        MODULE.validate_manifest_batch(manifests)

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "outside the batch"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest_batch(manifests[:1])

        conflicting = copy.deepcopy(manifests)
        conflicting[1]["catalog"]["track_order"] += 1
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "conflicting order"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest_batch(conflicting)

        global_track_collision = copy.deepcopy(manifests)
        global_track_collision[1]["catalog"]["track"] = {
            **global_track_collision[1]["catalog"]["track"],
            "source_key": "second-track",
            "slug": "second-track",
        }
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "global Track order"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest_batch(global_track_collision)

        course_order_collision = copy.deepcopy(manifests)
        course_order_collision[1]["catalog"]["course_order"] = course_order_collision[0]["catalog"]["course_order"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "already owned"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest_batch(course_order_collision)

        group_order_collision = copy.deepcopy(manifests)
        group_order_collision[1]["catalog"]["course_group"] = {
            **group_order_collision[1]["catalog"]["course_group"],
            "source_key": "foundation.beginner.second-group",
            "slug": "second-group",
        }
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "Course Group.*already owned"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest_batch(group_order_collision)

    def test_batch_validation_rejects_duplicate_owned_source_keys(self):
        manifests = self.make_cyclic_batch()
        manifests[1]["modules"][0]["source_key"] = manifests[0]["modules"][0]["source_key"]

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "duplicate source_key"):
            MODULE.validate_manifest_batch(manifests)

    def test_batch_apply_creates_all_entities_before_relations_and_is_idempotent(self):
        manifests = self.make_cyclic_batch()

        class BatchAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []
                self.resources = {
                    "track": set(),
                    "level": set(),
                    "course-group": set(),
                    "module": set(),
                    "section": set(),
                    "lesson": set(),
                    "task": set(),
                }
                self.catalog_slugs = {"track": {}, "level": {}, "course-group": {}}
                self.courses = {}
                self.task_kinds = {}

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if path == "/i18n/list":
                    return {"languages": [{"id": 1, "language": "en"}, {"id": 2, "language": "ru"}]}
                if path.startswith("/tech/list"):
                    return {"techs": [{"id": 11, "label": "neutral"}, {"id": 12, "label": "javascript"}]}
                if path.startswith("/tech-version/list"):
                    return {"tech_versions": [{"id": 21, "tech_id": 11, "version": "1"}]}
                if path.startswith("/code-structure-type/list"):
                    return {
                        "code_structure_types": [
                            {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011", "code": "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC"},
                            {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000012", "code": "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC"},
                            {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000013", "code": "TEST_ORDERING_BASIC"},
                            {"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000014", "code": "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_BASIC"},
                        ]
                    }
                if path.startswith("/tag/list"):
                    return {"tags": [{"id": 31, "slug": "neutral"}]}
                for endpoint, collection in (("track", "tracks"), ("level", "levels"), ("course-group", "course_groups")):
                    if path.startswith(f"/{endpoint}/list"):
                        return {
                            collection: [
                                {"id": resource_id, "slug": slug}
                                for resource_id, slug in self.catalog_slugs[endpoint].items()
                            ]
                        }
                if path.startswith("/course/list"):
                    return {"courses": [{"id": resource_id, "slug": slug} for resource_id, slug in self.courses.items()]}
                for kind, resources in self.resources.items():
                    prefix = f"/{kind}/get/"
                    if path.startswith(prefix):
                        resource_id = path[len(prefix) :]
                        if resource_id not in resources:
                            return None
                        if kind == "task":
                            return {"task_kind": self.task_kinds[resource_id]}
                        if kind == "lesson":
                            return {"id": resource_id, "status": 1}
                        return {"id": resource_id}
                if method == "POST" and path == "/course/create":
                    self.courses[body["id"]] = body["slug"]
                if method == "POST" and path in {
                    "/track/create",
                    "/level/create",
                    "/course-group/create",
                    "/module/create",
                    "/section/create",
                    "/lesson/create",
                    "/task/create",
                }:
                    kind = path.split("/")[1]
                    self.resources[kind].add(body["id"])
                    if kind in self.catalog_slugs:
                        self.catalog_slugs[kind][body["id"]] = body["slug"]
                    if kind == "task":
                        self.task_kinds[body["id"]] = body["task_kind"]
                if method == "PUT" and any(path.startswith(f"/{kind}/update/") for kind in self.catalog_slugs):
                    kind = path.split("/")[1]
                    resource_id = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
                    self.catalog_slugs[kind][resource_id] = body["slug"]
                return {}

            def upload_starter_files(self, *_):
                return None

        api = BatchAPI()
        first_actions = MODULE.apply_manifest_batch(manifests, api)
        first_call_count = len(api.calls)
        second_actions = MODULE.apply_manifest_batch(manifests, api)

        phase_one_indexes = [
            index
            for index, (method, path, _) in enumerate(api.calls[:first_call_count])
            if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/lesson-examples/replace/")
        ]
        relation_indexes = [
            index
            for index, (method, path, _) in enumerate(api.calls[:first_call_count])
            if method == "PUT" and (path.startswith("/lesson-relations/replace/") or path.startswith("/example-relations/replace/"))
        ]
        publish_indexes = [
            index
            for index, (method, path, body) in enumerate(api.calls[:first_call_count])
            if method == "PUT" and path.startswith("/course/update/") and "status" in body
        ]
        self.assertTrue(phase_one_indexes)
        self.assertTrue(relation_indexes)
        self.assertLess(max(phase_one_indexes), min(relation_indexes))
        self.assertLess(max(relation_indexes), min(publish_indexes))
        self.assertTrue(any(action.startswith("create  course") for actions in first_actions for action in actions))
        self.assertFalse(any(action.startswith("create  ") for actions in second_actions for action in actions))

    def test_batch_reference_failure_happens_before_any_write(self):
        manifests = self.make_cyclic_batch()
        manifests[1]["course"]["tag_slugs"] = ["missing-tag"]
        api = SeededReferenceAPI()

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "missing tag slug"):
            MODULE.apply_manifest_batch(manifests, api)

        self.assertTrue(api.calls)
        self.assertTrue(all(method == "GET" for method, _, _ in api.calls))

    def test_scoped_selectors_keep_minimal_paths_and_relation_dependencies(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        module = manifest["modules"][0]
        section = module["sections"][0]
        source_lesson, target_lesson = section["lessons"]
        source_example, target_example = manifest["examples"]

        scoped, scope = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
            [manifest],
            MODULE.ScopeSelector("task", source_lesson["tasks"][0]["source_key"]),
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(scoped), 1)
        task_document = scoped[0]
        self.assertEqual(len(task_document["modules"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(task_document["modules"][0]["sections"]), 1)
        task_lessons = task_document["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"]
        self.assertEqual([lesson["source_key"] for lesson in task_lessons], [source_lesson["source_key"]])
        self.assertEqual(
            [task["source_key"] for task in task_lessons[0]["tasks"]],
            [source_lesson["tasks"][0]["source_key"]],
        )
        self.assertNotIn("examples", task_document)
        self.assertNotIn("lesson_relations", task_document)
        self.assertNotIn("example_relations", task_document)
        self.assertTrue(scope.owns(source_lesson["tasks"][0]["source_key"]))
        self.assertTrue(scope.ensures_only(source_lesson["source_key"]))

        scoped, scope = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
            [manifest],
            MODULE.ScopeSelector("lesson", source_lesson["source_key"]),
        )
        lesson_document = scoped[0]
        lessons = lesson_document["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"]
        self.assertEqual(
            [lesson["source_key"] for lesson in lessons],
            [source_lesson["source_key"], target_lesson["source_key"]],
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(lessons[0]["tasks"]), len(source_lesson["tasks"]))
        self.assertEqual(lessons[1]["tasks"], [])
        self.assertEqual(
            {example["source_key"] for example in lesson_document["examples"]},
            {source_example["source_key"], target_example["source_key"]},
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(lesson_document["lesson_relations"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(lesson_document["example_relations"]), 1)
        self.assertIn(target_lesson["source_key"], scope.dependency_keys)
        self.assertIn(target_example["source_key"], scope.dependency_keys)

        scoped, scope = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
            [manifest],
            MODULE.ScopeSelector("example", source_example["source_key"]),
        )
        example_document = scoped[0]
        lessons = example_document["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"]
        self.assertTrue(all(lesson["tasks"] == [] for lesson in lessons))
        self.assertEqual(
            {example["source_key"] for example in example_document["examples"]},
            {source_example["source_key"], target_example["source_key"]},
        )
        self.assertNotIn("lesson_relations", example_document)
        self.assertEqual(len(example_document["example_relations"]), 1)
        self.assertTrue(scope.owns(source_example["source_key"]))
        self.assertTrue(scope.ensures_only(target_example["source_key"]))

        for kind, source_key in (
            ("track", manifest["catalog"]["track"]["source_key"]),
            ("course", manifest["course"]["source_key"]),
            ("module", module["source_key"]),
            ("section", section["source_key"]),
        ):
            with self.subTest(kind=kind):
                selected, selected_scope = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
                    [manifest],
                    MODULE.ScopeSelector(kind, source_key),
                )
                self.assertEqual(len(selected), 1)
                self.assertTrue(selected_scope.owns(source_key))
                self.assertEqual(sum(len(lesson["tasks"]) for lesson in MODULE.iter_lessons(selected[0])), 5)

    def test_scoped_selector_rejects_missing_and_wrong_kind(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "no matching entity"):
            MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
                [copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)],
                MODULE.ScopeSelector("lesson", "foundation.missing"),
            )
        course_key = self.neutral_manifest["course"]["source_key"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "exists as course"):
            MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
                [copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)],
                MODULE.ScopeSelector("module", course_key),
            )

    def test_scoped_task_apply_preserves_existing_ancestors(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        selected_task = lesson["tasks"][0]
        scoped, scope = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
            [manifest],
            MODULE.ScopeSelector("task", selected_task["source_key"]),
        )

        class ExistingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/task/get/"):
                    return {"task_kind": selected_task["task_kind"]}
                if method == "GET":
                    return {}
                return {}

            def upload_starter_files(self, *_):
                raise AssertionError("selected assessment task has no starter archive")

        api = ExistingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(scoped[0], api, scope)
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 2, "en": 1}
        importer.tech_ids = {"neutral": 12}
        importer.tech_version_ids = {(12, "1"): 22}
        importer.structure_type_ids = {"TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC": "structure-id"}
        importer.tag_ids = {"neutral": 33}

        importer.apply_content()
        importer.apply_semantic_relations()
        importer.publish_course()

        update_paths = [path for method, path, _ in api.calls if method == "PUT"]
        self.assertEqual(update_paths, ["/task/update/" + MODULE.source_uuid(selected_task["source_key"])])
        self.assertFalse(any("lesson-examples/replace" in path for _, path, _ in api.calls))
        self.assertFalse(any("lesson-relations/replace" in path for _, path, _ in api.calls))
        self.assertTrue(any(action.startswith("ensure  lesson") for action in importer.actions))
        self.assertTrue(any(action.startswith("ensure  course_publish") for action in importer.actions))

    def test_ownership_mode_auto_matches_all_and_scoped_imports(self):
        self.assertEqual(MODULE.resolve_ownership_mode(None, "auto"), "full")
        selector = MODULE.ScopeSelector("task", "foundation.task")
        self.assertEqual(MODULE.resolve_ownership_mode(selector, "auto"), "partial")
        self.assertEqual(MODULE.resolve_ownership_mode(None, "append"), "append")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "cannot be combined"):
            MODULE.resolve_ownership_mode(selector, "full")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(MODULE.ManifestError, "requires one scoped selector"):
            MODULE.resolve_ownership_mode(None, "partial")

    def test_full_ownership_aggregates_catalog_siblings_before_replace(self):
        first = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        second = copy.deepcopy(self.manifest)
        second["course"]["source_key"] += ".second"
        second["course"]["slug"] += "-second"
        second["catalog"]["course_order"] = first["catalog"]["course_order"] + 1

        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                return {}

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importers = [MODULE.ManifestImporter(item, api, ownership="full") for item in (first, second)]
        MODULE.reconcile_catalog_relations(importers)

        group_id = MODULE.source_uuid(first["catalog"]["course_group"]["source_key"])
        group_calls = [
            body
            for method, path, body in api.calls
            if method == "PUT" and path == "/course-group-relations/replace-courses/" + group_id
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(group_calls), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            {item["id"] for item in group_calls[0]["items"]},
            {MODULE.source_uuid(first["course"]["source_key"]), MODULE.source_uuid(second["course"]["source_key"])},
        )

    def test_task_reconciliation_deletes_only_for_owned_lesson(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        lesson = manifest["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        desired_id = MODULE.source_uuid(lesson["tasks"][0]["source_key"])
        stale_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000090"

        class StateAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/task/list?"):
                    return {
                        "tasks": [{"id": desired_id}, {"id": stale_id}],
                        "meta": {"total_pages": 1},
                    }
                return {}

        api = StateAPI()
        MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, api, ownership="full").delete_missing_tasks(
            lesson,
            MODULE.source_uuid(lesson["source_key"]),
        )
        self.assertIn(("DELETE", "/task/delete/" + stale_id, None), api.calls)
        self.assertFalse(any(method == "DELETE" and path.endswith(desired_id) for method, path, _ in api.calls))

        lesson_scoped, lesson_scope = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
            [manifest],
            MODULE.ScopeSelector("lesson", lesson["source_key"]),
        )
        selected_lesson = lesson_scoped[0]["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        selected_lesson_api = StateAPI()
        MODULE.ManifestImporter(
            lesson_scoped[0],
            selected_lesson_api,
            lesson_scope,
            "partial",
        ).delete_missing_tasks(
            selected_lesson,
            MODULE.source_uuid(selected_lesson["source_key"]),
        )
        self.assertIn(("DELETE", "/task/delete/" + stale_id, None), selected_lesson_api.calls)

        scoped, scope = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
            [manifest],
            MODULE.ScopeSelector("task", lesson["tasks"][0]["source_key"]),
        )
        scoped_lesson = scoped[0]["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
        partial_api = StateAPI()
        MODULE.ManifestImporter(scoped[0], partial_api, scope, "partial").delete_missing_tasks(
            scoped_lesson,
            MODULE.source_uuid(scoped_lesson["source_key"]),
        )
        self.assertEqual(partial_api.calls, [])

        append_api = StateAPI()
        MODULE.ManifestImporter(manifest, append_api, ownership="append").delete_missing_tasks(
            lesson,
            MODULE.source_uuid(lesson["source_key"]),
        )
        self.assertEqual(append_api.calls, [])

    def test_append_ownership_keeps_add_only_hierarchy_writes(self):
        class RecordingAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                return {}

        api = RecordingAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(self.manifest, api, ownership="append")
        importer.reconcile_ordered_relations(
            parent_source_key=self.manifest["course"]["source_key"],
            add_path="/course-relations/add-module/course-id",
            replace_path="/course-relations/replace-modules/course-id",
            child_field="module_id",
            items=[("module-id", 1)],
        )

        self.assertTrue(api.calls)
        self.assertTrue(all(method == "POST" for method, _, _ in api.calls))
        self.assertFalse(any("replace-modules" in path for _, path, _ in api.calls))

    def test_readback_collection_accepts_strict_and_partial_projections(self):
        first_key = "foundation.readback.first"
        second_key = "foundation.readback.second"
        sibling_key = "foundation.readback.sibling"
        first = {"id": MODULE.source_uuid(first_key), "source_key": first_key, "order": 1}
        second = {"id": MODULE.source_uuid(second_key), "source_key": second_key, "order": 2}
        sibling = {"id": MODULE.source_uuid(sibling_key), "source_key": sibling_key, "order": 0}

        self.assertEqual(
            MODULE.readback_collection_mismatches(
                "strict children",
                [(first_key, 1), (second_key, 2)],
                [first, second],
                strict=True,
                check_order=True,
            ),
            [],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            MODULE.readback_collection_mismatches(
                "partial children",
                [(first_key, 1), (second_key, 2)],
                [sibling, first, second],
                strict=False,
                check_order=True,
            ),
            [],
        )

    def test_readback_collection_reports_stale_members_and_wrong_order(self):
        first_key = "foundation.readback.first"
        second_key = "foundation.readback.second"
        first = {"id": MODULE.source_uuid(first_key), "source_key": first_key, "order": 2}
        second = {"id": MODULE.source_uuid(second_key), "source_key": second_key, "order": 1}

        mismatches = MODULE.readback_collection_mismatches(
            "owned children",
            [(first_key, 1)],
            [second, first],
            strict=True,
            check_order=True,
        )

        self.assertTrue(any("expected ordered ids" in item for item in mismatches), mismatches)
        self.assertTrue(any("expected order 1, got 2" in item for item in mismatches), mismatches)

    def test_scoped_example_merge_preserves_siblings_and_dependency_targets(self):
        manifest = copy.deepcopy(self.neutral_manifest)
        source_example, target_example = manifest["examples"]
        scoped, scope = MODULE.scoped_manifest_batch(
            [manifest],
            MODULE.ScopeSelector("example", source_example["source_key"]),
        )
        selected = next(item for item in scoped[0]["examples"] if item["source_key"] == source_example["source_key"])
        selected["translations"]["en"]["description"] = "updated selected example"
        sibling_key = source_example["source_key"] + ".sibling"

        def stored_example(example, *, source_key=None, order=None, description=None):
            key = source_key or example["source_key"]
            return {
                "id": MODULE.source_uuid(key),
                "source_key": key,
                "lesson_id": MODULE.source_uuid(example["lesson_source_key"]),
                "lesson_source_key": example["lesson_source_key"],
                "order": order or example["order"],
                "status": example["status"],
                "mode": example["mode"],
                "stacks": example["stacks"],
                "target_concepts": example["target_concepts"],
                "translations": [
                    {
                        "i18n_id": 2 if language == "ru" else 1,
                        "lang": language,
                        "title": translation["title"],
                        "description": description or translation["description"],
                    }
                    for language, translation in example["translations"].items()
                ],
            }

        existing_by_lesson = {
            source_example["lesson_source_key"]: [
                stored_example(source_example, description="old selected example"),
                stored_example(source_example, source_key=sibling_key, order=2, description="preserved sibling"),
            ],
            target_example["lesson_source_key"]: [stored_example(target_example)],
        }

        class ExampleAPI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def request(self, method, path, body=None, **_):
                self.calls.append((method, path, body))
                if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/lesson-examples/list/"):
                    lesson_id = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
                    for lesson_key, examples in existing_by_lesson.items():
                        if MODULE.source_uuid(lesson_key) == lesson_id:
                            return {"lesson_examples": copy.deepcopy(examples)}
                    return {"lesson_examples": []}
                return {}

        api = ExampleAPI()
        importer = MODULE.ManifestImporter(scoped[0], api, scope)
        importer.language_ids = {"ru": 2, "en": 1}
        importer.prepare_scoped_example_replacements()
        importer.replace_lesson_examples()

        writes = [(path, body) for method, path, body in api.calls if method == "PUT"]
        self.assertEqual(len(writes), 1)
        self.assertTrue(writes[0][0].endswith(MODULE.source_uuid(source_example["lesson_source_key"])))
        payloads = {item["source_key"]: item for item in writes[0][1]["examples"]}
        self.assertEqual(set(payloads), {source_example["source_key"], sibling_key})
        selected_translations = {item["i18n_id"]: item for item in payloads[source_example["source_key"]]["translations"]}
        self.assertEqual(selected_translations[1]["description"], "updated selected example")
        sibling_translations = {item["i18n_id"]: item for item in payloads[sibling_key]["translations"]}
        self.assertEqual(sibling_translations[1]["description"], "preserved sibling")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
